grammar_title: -ing 形式复习:动名词与现在分词(Review of the -ing form)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 3 Discovering Useful Structures:-ing 形式的复习(动名词作主语/宾语/表语;现在分词作定语/状语;-ing 作宾语补足语及与不定式对照)。句子地道、食物主题、-ing 形式唯一成立。

points.point: 动名词作主语 / 宾语 / 表语
points.overview: 动名词(doing)可作主语(Cooking is an art,作主语时谓语用单数)、作动词或介词的宾语(enjoy tasting / good at cooking)、作表语(Her hobby is baking)。

points.point: 现在分词作定语 / 状语
points.overview: 现在分词(doing)表主动或正在进行:作定语修饰名词(the boiling water = 正在沸腾的水)、作状语表伴随/时间/原因(Smiling, she served the soup. / Tasting the dish, he nodded.)。

points.point: -ing 作宾语补足语,及与不定式对照
points.overview: 感官动词(see/hear/watch/find)及 keep/leave + sb + doing 表'正在进行';并区分 stop/remember/try 等后接 to do(将要做)与 doing(做某事/做过)的不同含义。

questions.stem: "____ Chinese dishes at home is a great way to relax after school."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语应用动名词 Cooking,谓语 is 单数。

questions.stem: "My grandma enjoys ____ dumplings with the whole family on holidays."
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词 making。

questions.stem: "Her favourite hobby is ____ desserts for her friends at weekends."
questions.explanation: 表语位置用动名词 baking 说明 hobby 的内容。

questions.stem: "____ spicy food too often may not be good for your stomach."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语用动名词 Eating。

questions.stem: "The chef is good at ____ noodles into very thin, even strands."
questions.explanation: be good at 后接动名词 pulling。

questions.stem: "I really love ____ new dishes whenever I travel to a new city."
questions.explanation: love 后用动名词 tasting,表示一贯爱好。

questions.stem: "____ vegetables slowly helps your body take in more of the vitamins."
questions.explanation: 句首主语用动名词 Chewing,谓语 helps 单数。

questions.stem: "One good way of staying healthy is ____ down on sweet drinks."
questions.explanation: 表语位置用动名词 cutting 与主语 way 对应。

questions.stem: "He kept his weight down by ____ a modest amount of food each meal."
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词 eating。

questions.stem: "____ different categories of fresh food keeps our diet balanced."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语用动名词 Consuming,谓语 keeps 单数。

questions.stem: "My brother is afraid of ____ too many calories from junk food."
questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接动名词 taking in。

questions.stem: "What she likes most about cooking is ____ the fresh ingredients herself."
questions.explanation: 表语位置用动名词 choosing,与主语对应。

questions.stem: "____ a balanced diet matters more than counting every single calorie."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语用动名词 Keeping,谓语 matters 单数。

questions.stem: "The whole family insisted on ____ the dumplings together on New Year's Eve."
questions.explanation: insist on 后接动名词 wrapping。

questions.stem: "Her dream is ____ a small restaurant that serves authentic Sichuan food."
questions.explanation: 表语位置用动名词 opening 说明 dream 的内容。

questions.stem: "____ slowly allows your brain to tell your body when you are full."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语用动名词 Eating,谓语 allows 单数。

questions.stem: "Many vegetarians are fond of ____ beans and tofu instead of meat."
questions.explanation: be fond of 后接动名词 eating。

questions.stem: "____ healthy habits when young can protect you for the rest of your life."
questions.explanation: 句首作主语用动名词 Forming,谓语 can 对应。

questions.stem: "The secret of his soup is ____ the bones for several hours over low heat."
questions.explanation: 表语位置用动名词 boiling 说明 secret 的内容。

questions.stem: "She thanked the chef for ____ her how to make the famous red braised pork."
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后接动名词 teaching。

questions.stem: "Be careful with the ____ water; it can burn your hand at once."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 boiling 作定语,表'正在沸腾的'(主动/进行)。

questions.stem: "____, the waiter brought us a pot of hot soup and a warm smile."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Smiling 作伴随状语,表主动同时进行。

questions.stem: "____ the strange new dish carefully, he finally nodded with delight."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Tasting 作状语,与主语 he 主动关系。

questions.stem: "The girl ____ at the next table is enjoying a bowl of beef noodles."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 sitting 作定语,表'正坐着的'。

questions.stem: "We could smell the bread ____ in the oven as we walked past the shop."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 baking 作定语,表'正在烤的'。

questions.stem: "____ that the soup was too salty, the chef quickly added more water."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Realising 作原因状语,与主语主动。

questions.stem: "There is a long line of people ____ for the famous dumplings outside."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 waiting 作定语,表'正在等候的'。

questions.stem: "____ in a bamboo steamer, the dim sum looked small and elegant."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Sitting 作状语,与主语 dim sum 主动关系。

questions.stem: "The chef stood by the fire, ____ the lamb kebab until it turned golden."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 roasting 作伴随状语,表主动进行。

questions.stem: "Look at the steam ____ from the bowl of freshly cooked rice!"
questions.explanation: 现在分词 rising 作定语,表'正在升起的'。

questions.stem: "____ hungry and tired, we were glad to find a small noodle shop."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Feeling 作状语,与主语 we 主动。

questions.stem: "The waiter showed us a menu ____ both Chinese and English names."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 listing 作定语,表'列出……的'(主动)。

questions.stem: "____ the recipe step by step, she made the dish on her first try."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Following 作状语,与主语主动。

questions.stem: "The customers ____ at the round table ordered three Hunan dishes."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 sitting 作定语,表'正坐着的'。

questions.stem: "____ the spicy fish head, the foreign guest asked for the recipe at once."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Loving 作原因状语,与主语主动。

questions.stem: "A pot of soup ____ slowly on the stove filled the kitchen with a nice smell."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 cooking 作定语,表'正在炖煮的'。

questions.stem: "____ at the busy cafeteria, the students chose their lunch quickly."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Arriving 作时间状语,与主语主动。

questions.stem: "He pointed at the chef ____ the dough high into the air."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 tossing 作定语,表'正在抛甩的'(主动)。

questions.stem: "____ that family meant so much there, I joined them in making dumplings."
questions.explanation: 现在分词 Knowing 作原因状语,与主语主动。

questions.stem: "The dish ____ with hot red peppers became the most popular one."
questions.explanation: 菜'被'辣椒覆盖,主语与 cover 是被动关系,用过去分词 covered;此处考查 -ing 与 -ed 的对照,过去分词表被动。

questions.stem: "From the door I saw the chef ____ a huge pot of soup over the fire."
questions.explanation: see sb doing 表'看到正在做',强调动作进行,用 stirring。

questions.stem: "I'm sorry to keep you ____ — the dumplings will be ready in a minute."
questions.explanation: keep sb doing 表让某人一直处于某状态,用 waiting。

questions.stem: "We could hear the oil ____ in the wok before the vegetables went in."
questions.explanation: hear sth doing 表'听到正在……',用 hissing。

questions.stem: "She left the soup ____ on low heat while she sliced the green onions."
questions.explanation: leave sth doing 表让某物持续某动作,用 simmering。

questions.stem: "When I walked in, I found my mother ____ the dough for tomorrow's buns."
questions.explanation: find sb doing 表'发现某人正在做',用 kneading。

questions.stem: "We watched the noodle master ____ one piece of dough into many strands."
questions.explanation: watch sb doing 强调动作的进行过程,用 pulling。

questions.stem: "On a winter day, nothing beats sitting by the fire and ____ hot soup."
questions.explanation: 与前面 sitting 并列,介词结构后用动名词 drinking。

questions.stem: "Remember ____ the rice before you start, or there will be nothing to cook."
questions.explanation: remember to do 表'记得去做(还没做)';洗米在做菜前,用 to wash。

questions.stem: "I still remember ____ that wonderful Sichuan meal for the very first time."
questions.explanation: remember doing 表'记得做过(已发生)';第一次品尝已是过去,用 tasting。

questions.stem: "After two hours of cooking, the tired chef stopped ____ a short rest."
questions.explanation: stop to do 表'停下来去做另一件事';停下做菜去休息,用 to take。

questions.stem: "If the soup is too salty, you should stop ____ so much salt next time."
questions.explanation: stop doing 表'停止正在做的事';不再放盐,用 adding。

questions.stem: "The recipe looked hard, but he tried ____ the dish exactly as it said."
questions.explanation: try to do 表'努力尝试去做';他努力照食谱做,用 to make。

questions.stem: "The soup tasted flat, so she tried ____ a little vinegar to it."
questions.explanation: try doing 表'试着用某法看效果';试着加点醋,用 adding。

questions.stem: "I noticed several customers ____ photos of the elegant dim sum."
questions.explanation: notice sb doing 表'注意到正在做',用 taking。

questions.stem: "The smell of garlic kept the whole family ____ around the kitchen."
questions.explanation: keep sb doing 表让某人持续某动作,用 gathering。

questions.stem: "She felt her mouth ____ the moment she smelled the spicy fish head."
questions.explanation: feel sth doing 表'感到正在……',用 watering。

questions.stem: "Please don't forget ____ the gas after the soup is ready."
questions.explanation: forget to do 表'忘记去做(尚未做)';关火尚未做,用 to turn off。

questions.stem: "I'll never forget ____ dumplings with my grandma when I was a child."
questions.explanation: forget doing 表'忘记做过的事';童年包饺子已发生,用 making。

questions.stem: "We observed the local people ____ their bread over an open fire."
questions.explanation: observe sb doing 表'观察到正在做',用 roasting。

questions.stem: "The waiter caught a child ____ to reach the dishes on the high shelf."
questions.explanation: catch sb doing 表'撞见某人正在做',用 trying。
